ElectrifyingEconomiesDescription: Electrifying Economies is an information platform demonstrating the role distributed energy will play in ending energy poverty and catalyzing a green and equitable recovery from the Covid-19 crisis. It has been jointly developed by Rockefeller Foundation, Rocky Mountain Institute, and Sustainable Energy for All.
EnergyAccessExplorerDescription: Energy Access Explorer is an online, open-source, interactive platform that uses mapping to visualize the state of energy access in unserved and underserved areas. It analyzes credible and public data to make the connection between the demand and supply of energy. The platform is led by World Resources Institute (WRI). financial models. It is implemented by AfDB, Sustainable Energy for All Africa Hub, SEFA, Energy4Impact, and Inensus.
